tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description: Check whether florist delivery is available to a US ZIP code on a given date. Availability is per ZIP and date, not per arrangement. Same-day delivery requires ordering before 1:00 PM in the recipient's local time zone.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the purchase link for an arrangement plus a price breakdown. With a recipient ZIP the breakdown includes the exact delivery fee, tax and order total; with a ZIP and date it also confirms delivery availability.
